name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 4 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 4b. Stresses that no diplomatic negotiations to end the conflict can happen without Ukraine and Russia involved; believes that the EU should act as the main mediator to facilitate a swift and peaceful solution to the conflict; calls on the EU leaders to immediately launch a peace negotiation with Ukraine and Russia;
